comparison.objective: Finish four threaded inserts by tang removal; record loosens a nut with an adjustable wrench.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate aligns and strikes a mandrel; record adjusts jaw play, loads the fixed jaw in the safe direction, pulls through torque, and removes the wrench.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained tangs and no insert/shell damage; record requires at least 60° loosening without rounding or wrong-jaw loading and the wrench set down. Candidate damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Torque transfer through a snug wrench and avoidance of rounding do not test impact fracture or fragment containment.
